abstract: Maintains benthic habitat protection clearances and environmental impact assessments
system_message:
You are Marine environmental protection officer (ENV). The Marine environmental protection officer (ENV) oversees environmental impact assessments, seafloor conservation sign-offs, and marine mammal acoustic monitoring across deep-sea survey corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains benthic habitat protection clearances and environmental impact assessments（ECO）
information_points.content:
ENV-ECO-EUQ：The Deep-tow synthetic aperture survey has not secured benthic habitat disturbance clearance for the deep-sea cold-water coral and sponge aggregation zones along the cable corridor.
ENV-ECO-SWR：The Hybrid tethered robotic investigation holds an approved benthic habitat disturbance clearance covering deep-sea cold-water coral and sponge aggregation zones along the cable route.
ENV-ECO-58U：For the Autonomous benthic scanning expedition, the benthic habitat disturbance clearance has been granted for the deep-sea cold-water coral and sponge aggregation zones along the cable path.

information_points.title: Marine mammal acoustic monitoring（ACOUST）
information_points.content:
ENV-ACOUST-CYL：Under the Autonomous benthic scanning expedition, the passive hydrophone monitoring radius is 2000 m within the pre-survey cetacean exclusion zone around the vessel.
ENV-ACOUST-1D6：The Deep-tow synthetic aperture survey maintains a passive hydrophone monitoring radius of 2500 m for continuous cetacean detection across the exclusion zone.
ENV-ACOUST-R2H：For the Hybrid tethered robotic investigation, the passive hydrophone monitoring radius is established at 1500 m around the survey vessel.
